question: Which of the following cities hosted the 4-day India International Cherry Blossom festival in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Shillong.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shillong** hosted the **4-day India International Cherry Blossom festival **in 2019.
 
• It was celebrated from **13th to 16th November 2019.**
 
• It was inaugurated by the **Meghalaya Chief Minister, Conrad K Sangma. **
 
• The festival celebrates the unique **autumn flowering** of Himalayan Cherry Blossoms with several cultural events.
 
• The festival is a great example of how natural resources and sustainable tourism can be utilized in an effective manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some other important festivals celebrated in North-East India
 
 
• **Losar - Arunachal Pradesh**
 
• **Saga Dawa - Sikkim**
 
• **Ambubachi Mela - Assam**
 
• **Dree Festival -Arunachal Pradesh**
 
• **Anthurium - Mizoram**
